comment: Domestically financed national infrastructure is treated as the desired sustainability state. Some countries may sustainably use regional shared services, pooled procurement, multilateral financing, or long-term partner support.

public.text: Domestically financed national infrastructure is treated as the desired sustainability state. Some countries may sustainably use regional shared services, pooled procurement, multilateral financing, or long-term partner support.
public.suggestedRevision: Define sustainability as predictable, accountable, and resilient financing under national governance, rather than requiring exclusively domestic financing.
